notes.title: Yearly update
notes.notes:
Another year, another update. Hive P v. S has received its annual checkup to make sure everything is running smoothly. In addition some improvements have been made.

Change log for 1.0.895 release
[list]
[*] Maintenance update with updated dependencies.
[*] Performance improvement.
[*] Updated manual and tutorial with level progression information.
[*] Escape pauses / shows the menu (in addition to M and P keys).
[*] Mouse movement when running fullscreen on a Mac has been fixed.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Maintenance update
notes.notes:

notes.title: Steam achievements delux
notes.notes:
With 40 newly added achievements to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562150/Hive_P_v_S/]Hive P v. S[/url], there has never been a better time to fail at getting a high score. It's OK to not have the skill for it, you'll get a pat on the back and off you go to try again. You can do it!

There are achievements to be received for being great, for being new or for simply being. Enjoy.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562150/Hive_P_v_S/]Hive P v. S[/url] will be on a 50% off sale starting this evening on the 2nd of May.[/b]

notes.title: Out now!
notes.notes:
Hive P v. S is a high score driven collect, avoid and destroy arcade game that is out now for Windows, Mac, Linux, Android and iOS devices. Game retails for $2.99 and is available now as an immediate download.

Hive P v. S is a casual arcade game that starts with a low pace, easy to get into gameplay. As the player progress, the game transforms into a hectic, "on your toes"-score collector, where using the right power-up at the right time is crucial for success. Hive P v. S features easy to use controls for mouse, gamepad or touch and a high score table shared for all the different platforms. Which platform has the best point collectors?
